title: Graduation Gift
about: A dartboard Kenny gave me as a graduation gift at the end of my final year in State Arts-In.
description: This track reflects on graduating from State Arts-In in 2019 and how an ordinary object became tied to the end of that chapter. As the costumes, stage, songs, and people began moving on, Kenny gave me a dartboard as a graduation gift. Years later, it still hangs on my wall and serves as a physical reminder of the people, performances, and years that shaped me.
lyrics: The stage was slowly taken back.
The songs we'd lived began to fade,
No one tells you when you'll miss it,
While you're standing in the middle.
One more rehearsal, one more song,
Thinking there'll be years this long.
Then someone hands you one small gift,
A simple thing that somehow hits.
A dartboard hanging on my wall...
Still reminds me of it all.
Still I hear the laughter there,
Nothing stays the way it seems,
Life keeps trading years for dreams.
The people who helped shape your name,
Leave a mark that still remains.
No one tells you when you'll miss it,
One last bow beneath the lights,
A dartboard hanging on my wall...
Still reminds me of it all.
